milestones.name: First steps
milestones.explain: Small, visible wins build trust: a community garden in Linden Flats, retrofits across three neighbourhoods, and a town that reaches satisfaction 60.

milestones.name: Getting around
milestones.explain: The plan's checklist adds bus lines and safe-street networks with later content; the measurable goal now is average mobility coverage 0.65 with six projects running.

milestones.name: A greener river
milestones.explain: The plan's river-restoration tasks (rain gardens, wetlands, meadows) arrive with later content; the measurable goal is green space and a full town-wide project list.

milestones.name: Closing loops
milestones.explain: Compost points and tool libraries join the projects later; the measurable goal now is waste coverage 0.70 across the town.

milestones.name: Community-owned
milestones.explain: The energy co-op and half-local-electricity checklist arrive later; the measurable goal now is clean energy and high satisfaction town-wide.
